title: Establish MVP build, provenance, and release artifact flow
purpose: Make MVP artifacts reproducible enough to test, audit, and hand off without relying on local machine state.
scope: Define build commands for agentd binary, rootfs/image, tests, and boot smoke test.
Generate basic SBOM or dependency inventory for binaries and image inputs.
Record provenance metadata: source revision or workspace hash, build time, toolchain version, image inputs.
Document artifact retention and promotion rules.
acceptance_criteria: A clean machine can reproduce the core MVP build steps from documented commands.
Release artifact metadata identifies source, toolchain, and image inputs.
Safety regression tests and boot smoke tests run before artifact promotion.
Secrets are not embedded in release artifacts or provenance output.
verification: Confirm clean build does not depend on untracked local state.
risk_notes: Supply-chain discipline should start in MVP because agentd controls privileged system paths.
